patch.value: Home Assistant Core 2026.8.0 provides stable WebSocket contracts for manifest/list, manifest/get, integration/setup_info, integration/descriptions, integration/wait, entity/source, and slugify. The current CLI supports these only through raw ws call. This feature adds a discoverable typed surface with bounded output and preserves generic passthrough for integration-defined evolution.
Expose stable Home Assistant Core integration metadata, readiness, and entity provenance contracts through typed agent-friendly commands.

Typed commands cover integration list/get/setup/descriptions/wait, entity source provenance, and slug generation with validated inputs and detailed help; Outputs remain deterministic and valid across TOON, JSON, compact JSON, YAML, table, and Markdown; Schema, capabilities, README, API reference, docs index, LLM guidance, and agent optimization documentation stay synchronized; Unit, integration, command-help, setup wizard, live read-only, security, PM, release, and exact 100/100/100/100 coverage gates pass
Official 2026.8.0 source contracts and live instance support are verified; all-status duplicate search returns no canonical equivalent.
Let agents understand loaded integrations and entity ownership without raw protocol knowledge.
Improves planning, diagnostics, compatibility analysis, and prompt-efficient topology discovery.
A production-ready typed discovery surface with private-instance-safe evidence and full release readiness.
Home Assistant 2026.8.0 shipped today and the latest contract review identified this cohesive remaining Core discovery gap.
